title: 第12章 温润如玉大师兄
novel_title: 伪装隐世仙族后，大佬疯狂跪舔我
content_zh:
微生璃月不知道自己是怎么熬过来的，只知道她醒来时，统子说自己差点把月神殿的灵力吸干。

    要不是月神殿自带的聚灵阵法发挥了作用，她这天阶法宝就该玩完了。

    不过因为聚灵阵法的功效，太虚宗附近大部分灵气短时间内都被吸到她这里，宗里长老们对这事有些议论。

    发现剑峰那里又搞出了动静，慕鹤云本想派个人过来查看情况，可长老们面面相觑，愣是没人敢站出来。

    后面剑峰那边停止吸收灵气，被吸走的灵气又重新生成，这事也就了了。

    ……

    这边，微生璃月在醒来后查了下自己的身体情况，她已经顺利引气入体进入练气五层，相比于原著里需要一月才能引气入体，倒也是个不错的开始。

    在尝试用灵力凝结几个小法术后，微生璃月忽然想起自己好像还有三颗神兽蛋，昨天光顾着修炼，差点把它们给忘了。

    灵光闪过，三颗颜色不一、足有半人高的巨蛋就出现在房间里。

    微生璃月围着这三颗红、白、黑巨蛋绕了几圈，疑惑道：“统子，你知道这几颗神兽蛋里面都是什么神兽吗？”

    以她看小说的经验，一般修仙文里头，男女主身边的神兽一出场，不是朱雀凤凰，就是上古神龙。

    原剧情里头，叶不凡后期在秘境里捡到的神兽蛋好像就是一颗具有上古金龙血脉的神兽蛋，最后在男主的帮助下血脉返祖，彻底进化成金龙，成为一方大佬。

    那自己这几颗神兽蛋里，会不会也有神龙或者凤凰？

    “很抱歉阿璃，对于系统空间出品的神兽蛋，系统没有物种扫描权限，能开出什么神兽我也不知道。”

    没能替宿主解决问题，装逼系统有一点小小的失落，它堂堂装逼系统，竟然也有办不到的事情，这多有损它在阿璃面前高大上的形象。

    “不知道那就算了吧！反正都是神兽蛋，再差也差不到哪里去。”

    说这个话的时候，微生璃月还不知道未来她会为这几颗神兽蛋愁到掉头发。

    按照系统的指示给这几颗神兽蛋喂了一些极品灵石加速孵化后，微生璃月收到了二师姐的传讯，说是大师兄醒了，想要见见师傅新收的两位小师妹。
content_en:
Weisheng Liyue didn't know how she survived. She only knew that when she woke up, Tongzi said that she almost drained the spiritual power of the Moon Temple.

If the Moon Temple's built-in spirit gathering formation hadn't come into play, her heavenly magic weapon would have been finished.

However, due to the effect of the spirit gathering formation, most of the spiritual energy near Taixu Sect was sucked to her in a short period of time, and the elders in the sect had some discussions about this matter.

Upon discovering that there was another commotion at Jianfeng, Mu Heyun wanted to send someone over to check the situation, but the elders looked at each other in shock, but no one dared to step forward.

The Jianfeng side at the back stopped absorbing spiritual energy, and the absorbed spiritual energy was regenerated, so that was the end of the matter.

…

Here, Weisheng Liyue checked her physical condition after waking up. She had successfully introduced Qi into her body and entered the fifth level of Qi training. Compared with the original work, which took a month to introduce Qi into her body, it was a good start.

After trying to condense a few small spells with her spiritual power, Weisheng Liyue suddenly remembered that she seemed to have three mythical beast eggs. She was busy practicing yesterday and almost forgot about them.

A flash of inspiration occurred, and three giant eggs of different colors, half as tall as a man, appeared in the room.

Weisheng Liyue circled the three red, white and black giant eggs several times and asked doubtfully: "Tongzi, do you know what kind of mythical beasts are inside these mythical beast eggs?"

Based on her experience in reading novels, in general fairy tales, when the mythical beasts around the hero and heroine appear, they are either the Suzaku Phoenix or the ancient dragon.

In the original plot, the mythical beast egg that Ye Bufan picked up in the secret realm in the later period seemed to be a mythical beast egg with the bloodline of an ancient golden dragon. Finally, with the help of the male protagonist, the bloodline returned to the ancestors, completely evolved into a golden dragon, and became a big boss.

Then, are there dragons or phoenixes in these mythical beast eggs?

"I'm sorry Ali, the system does not have species scanning authority for the mythical beast eggs produced in the system space, and I don't know what kind of mythical beasts can be produced."

It failed to solve the problem for the host, and the pretentious system was a little disappointed. It was a pretentious system, but there were things it couldn't do. This greatly damaged its high-ranking image in front of Ali.

"I don't know, so forget it! They are all mythical beast eggs anyway, no matter how bad they are, they can't be much different."

When she said this, Weisheng Liyue didn't know that she would lose her hair worrying about these mythical beast eggs in the future.

After following the instructions of the system and feeding these divine beast eggs with some top-quality spiritual stones to speed up their hatching, Weisheng Liyue received a message from the second senior sister, saying that the senior brother had woken up and wanted to meet the two new junior sisters that the master had accepted.
title_en: Chapter 12: Senior Brother, Gentle as Jade
